title: Rejection probability of the all-zero tester
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $w\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ be a Boolean string. The rejection probability of the tester that samples a coordinate uniformly and rejects exactly when its value is $1$ equals the fraction of coordinates $i$ for which $w(i)=1$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $n$
